purpose: Challenge the fixed methods without tuning or promoting live defaults
shared_processing: Unchanged from protocol.json and fixed extraction methods at 2140db8
scoring: Score injected-rate error only in pulse-present cases; report all-case coverage, abstentions, accepted error and errors over 5 BPM. Score pulse-absent controls separately as spurious-candidate rates. Also compare error on the common accepted pulse-present set.
selection: Full Cartesian grid for pulse-present cases; each negative control across every base color, frame rate and seed without a redundant pulse-direction dimension
limitations: Arbitrary RGB stress directions are not a skin-tone or physiological population model. No video, tracking, camera auto-exposure or independent natural reference. All cases are post-initial-study challenge cases, not a new unseen clinical holdout. Methods, filters and gates stay fixed.
